mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as days, COALESCE(AVG(gb_ai_daily_revenue_gross_revenue), 0) as avg_daily_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(gb_ai_daily_revenue_gross_revenue), 0) as total_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(gb_ai_daily_revenue_dine_in_orders + gb_ai_daily_revenue_takeout_orders), 0) as total_orders, COALESCE(AVG(gb_ai_daily_revenue_dine_in_orders + gb_ai_daily_revenue_takeout_orders), 0) as avg_order_count, COALESCE(AVG((gb_ai_daily_revenue_dine_in_revenue + gb_ai_daily_revenue_takeout_revenue) / NULLIF((gb_ai_daily_revenue_dine_in_customers + gb_ai_daily_revenue_takeout_orders), 0)), 0) as avg_per_customer, COALESCE(SUM(gb_ai_daily_revenue_platform_fee), 0) as total_coupon_amount, 0 as total_refund_amount, COALESCE(MAX(gb_ai_daily_revenue_gross_revenue), 0) as max_daily_revenue, COALESCE(MIN(gb_ai_daily_revenue_gross_revenue), 0) as min_daily_revenue, -- 新增外卖相关统计 COALESCE(SUM(gb_ai_daily_revenue_takeout_revenue), 0) as total_takeout_revenue, COALESCE(AVG(gb_ai_daily_revenue_takeout_revenue), 0) as avg_takeout_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(gb_ai_daily_revenue_takeout_revenue - gb_ai_daily_revenue_platform_fee), 0) as total_takeout_net, COALESCE(AVG(gb_ai_daily_revenue_takeout_revenue - gb_ai_daily_revenue_platform_fee), 0) as avg_takeout_net FROM gb_ai_daily_revenue WHERE gb_ai_daily_revenue_department_id = #{departmentId}
